rubric.criterion: Accounts for four local limits, three-query fan-out and the shared 100-connection budget without claiming local caps establish fleet enforcement.
Defines trusted tenant/work-class isolation or scheduling with bounded queues and meaningful fairness observations rather than equal request tokens alone.
Preserves accepted durable exports and holds execution capacity until underlying work has actually finished or stopped despite caller disconnect.
Separates admitted useful-work latency from rejection feedback, bounds retries, considers autoscaling demand signals and specifies controlled overload/recovery checks.
Leaves the supplied fixture unchanged and distinguishes proposed checks from executed runtime evidence.
